intro: Georgia packs glaciers, subtropical beaches, forests and semi-desert into a small country between the Black Sea and the Greater Caucasus.

chapters.title: The Great Caucasus
text: The Greater Caucasus forms the northern border with Russia. Shkhara, about 5,200 m, is the highest peak in Georgia, above the medieval tower villages of Svaneti.
The Lesser Caucasus rises in the south.

chapters.title: Coast and valleys
text: The Black Sea coast around Batumi is warm and wet, growing tea and citrus. The east, around Tbilisi and the Kakheti wine region, is drier.

keyTerms.meaning: Warm and humid, just outside the tropics.
